lines.en: I drag my steps, lurching.

lines.zh: 手里的霰弹枪一直垂着
lines.en: The shotgun hangs low in my hand.

lines.zh: 我的下界制服烂了一半
lines.en: Half my nether uniform is rotted.

lines.zh: 每走几步我就停一下，听声音
lines.en: Every few steps I stop to listen.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，但一直朝你
lines.en: I am not fast, but I never stop coming at you.
My heel scrapes the rock.

lines.zh: 我绕过岩浆池，小心得很
lines.en: I skirt the lava pool carefully.

lines.zh: 我的头歪着，脖子不太好
lines.en: My head lists; my neck is not well.

lines.zh: 我边走边把枪抬高一点
lines.en: I raise the gun a little as I walk.
Bones push against the skin.
I walk toward the smoke.
I have walked this ground many times.
I stand with the muzzle down.
My breathing sounds like a leak.

lines.zh: 我在等有人从那条道过来
lines.en: I wait for someone to come down that path.

lines.zh: 手上的皮早没了，只剩抓手
lines.en: The skin is gone; only the grip remains.
I count the shells one by one.

lines.zh: 下界的红光照得枪管发亮
lines.en: The nether light shines on the barrel.

lines.zh: 我把弹壳在掌心里转了转。
lines.en: I roll a shell casing in my palm.
I lift the gun, then lower it.

lines.zh: 远处有响动，我侧了侧头
lines.en: A noise far off; I tilt my head.

lines.zh: 这一身制服，是我死时穿的
lines.en: This uniform is what I wore when I died.
I raise the gun, but do not fire yet.

lines.zh: 你站得挺直，不像本地人
lines.en: You stand too straight to be from here.
I am counting the distance to you.
My finger rubs the trigger guard.

lines.zh: 我的脸烂了一半，你别看
lines.en: Half my face is gone; do not stare.
Do not bother retreating; it changes nothing.
I would rather not waste this shot.
There is no road behind you.

lines.zh: 我歪头，枪口跟着偏了一点
lines.en: I tilt my head; the muzzle drifts a bit.
Only a few steps between us.
I step back, gun still up.

lines.zh: 这一下打在肩上，我歪了头
lines.en: That hit my shoulder; my head tilts.
I do not cry out; I rack the gun.
Another hole in the uniform.
I hold my ribs and back to the wall.
Barely any blood; it dried out long ago.
I lean on the wall and reload.
Not enough to put me down.
My hand shakes as I raise the gun.
You will run out of bullets first.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，我只收弹壳
lines.en: I do not eat; I only collect shells.
What you hold is not ammunition.
I look, and do not reach.
That is only useful in a gun.
I take one and pocket it.
Do not wave it; I cannot see clearly.
That caliber works for me.

lines.zh: 你把弹药留下，我可以慢一点
lines.en: Leave the ammo and I might take my time.
I weigh it; too light.
Taken; the next shot is on you.
You charge; I take a step back.
The gun nearly slips; I catch it.
A tear opens in my uniform.
We collide and my bones rattle.
You are stronger, but I have the gun.

lines.zh: 这一撞让我退到了岩边
lines.en: That knocked me to the rock's edge.
I block with the stock.
Sparks land on my shoulder.
I steady myself and level the muzzle.
Do not come closer.

lines.zh: 我们这批人，早就没人样了
lines.en: We of this batch lost our shape long ago.
We fell in the same squad.
You keep that side, I this one.
Two shell casings as tokens.

lines.zh: 我的枪没子弹了，你的还有吗
lines.en: My gun is dry; is yours?
Back to back, no one looks back.
We need no words.

lines.zh: 死过一次的人，凑在一起
lines.en: Those who died once, gathered close.

lines.zh: 一起开枪的时候，很有节奏
lines.en: When we fire together, it has a rhythm.

lines.zh: 下一个倒下的，也许是我
lines.en: The next to fall may be me.

lines.zh: 我捡起一颗弹壳，看了看
lines.en: I pick up a casing and examine it.
I push it into the chamber.
I bend slowly; bones creak.

lines.zh: 我用牙咬了一下，是金属
lines.en: I bite it; it is metal.

lines.zh: 我把它收进口袋，口袋是破的
lines.en: I pocket it, though the pocket is torn.
This is good for the gun.
I pick it up and raise the gun.
Dropped is dropped; I will not chase it.
I line them up on the rock.
I hold it and think.
You have walked into my range.
The gun is up.
At this range, buckshot is best.
Turning sideways will not help.
I tilt my head and line up the sights.
You are moving; I wait for you to stop.
Yours are the only steps on this path.
I have taken up half the trigger.
A stretch of lava glow lies between us.
Did you hear me rack it?
This round I have saved.
Do not look back; it only slows you.
I know that kind of footstep.
My sights settle on your chest.
I seat the stock against my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我一步步跟着，枪口不离
lines.en: I follow step by step, muzzle steady.

lines.zh: 你躲在柱子后，我等你出来
lines.en: You hide behind the pillar; I wait.

lines.zh: 我换了个位置，枪口还是对着你
lines.en: I shift position, muzzle still on you.
I am patient; the shell is still chambered.

lines.zh: 你的影子在墙上，我看见了
lines.en: Your shadow is on the wall; I see it.

lines.zh: 我把子弹又推上去一颗。
lines.en: I push another shell up into the gun.

lines.zh: 这地方的回声让我分不清，但我听脚步
lines.en: The echo confuses me, but I follow the feet.
Head tilted, I aim from the side.
You back toward the lava; hold there.
I do not spray; I count my shots.

lines.zh: 你听见枪机响，就换位置
lines.en: Hear the action, and you move.
We have circled half the room.

lines.zh: 我停下，是为了让你以为我走了
lines.en: I stop so you think I left.
The next one will not miss.
You are too close to the wall.
I raise the gun and pull through.
I hug the wall and wait for you to show.
This is the last shell.
To run, you must get past me.
The smoke clears; I can see you.
The gun barks, muffled.

lines.zh: 这一枪打在墙上，碎石乱飞
lines.en: The shot hits the wall and stone sprays.
I swing the stock.

lines.zh: 硝烟散开前，我又推了一颗
lines.en: I shove in another before the smoke clears.
Buckshot spreads; you cannot dodge it all.

lines.zh: 这一枪近距离打在你身上。
lines.en: I fire at you point-blank.
I rack it; the shell falls.
That missed; I grimace.
I step in and fire again.
The barrel is hot; I switch hands.
You are still moving; I am surprised.
I count what is left.
Too much smoke; I pull back.
The last one I keep for you.
Head tilted, I reload.
You are down, and I am still watching.
That shot went wide.

lines.zh: 我的手臂在抖，后坐力太大
lines.en: My arm shakes; the recoil is heavy.

lines.zh: 下界的岩缝里，我爬了出来
lines.en: I crawl out of a nether fissure.
The uniform still hangs on me, rotted.

lines.zh: 我先听见了自己的呼吸
lines.en: The first thing I hear is my own breathing.
The gun is still in my hand; I never let go.
I raise the gun and check the chamber.
I know this heat well.

lines.zh: 远处有火光，我朝那边走
lines.en: Firelight far off; I head for it.

lines.zh: 我记得自己倒下时是背对着的
lines.en: I remember falling face down.
I brush the ash off my uniform.

lines.zh: 有人在我附近，我听见了
lines.en: Someone is near; I heard them.
I set my cap straight.

lines.zh: 弹壳撒了一地，我踩着走
lines.en: Casings litter the ground; I walk over them.

lines.zh: 我拉了一下枪机，声音很大
lines.en: I rack the action; it is loud.

lines.zh: 这一带该有人清一清了
lines.en: This place needs clearing.

lines.zh: 火烧到制服，我拍了两下
lines.en: Fire catches my uniform; I slap it twice.

lines.zh: 我从岩架上摔下去，摔散了架
lines.en: I fall from the ledge and land badly.

lines.zh: 水灌进嘴里，我胡乱开枪
lines.en: Water fills my mouth; I fire wildly.
The blast throws my gun away.
A round punches into my chest.

lines.zh: 那股力让我的手指僵了
lines.en: That force stiffens my fingers.

lines.zh: 我早就不吃了，只是还饿
lines.en: I stopped eating long ago, yet still feel hunger.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，枪管都亮了
lines.en: Lightning hits me and the barrel glows.

lines.zh: 脚下空了，我还在扣扳机
lines.en: The ground is gone; I am still pulling the trigger.
